entries.task_id: magh|shoh|dy chairyssyn deiney cour y theihll slane myr towse cadjin jeh cooilleeney son dy chooilley phobble as dy chooilley ashoon
entries.description: MAGH shoh DY CHAIRYSSYN DEINEY COUR Y THEIHLL SLANE myr towse cadjin jeh cooilleeney son dy chooilley phobble as dy chooilley ashoon
entries.subject: MAGH
entries.object: DY CHAIRYSSYN DEINEY COUR Y THEIHLL SLANE myr towse cadjin jeh cooilleeney son dy chooilley phobble as dy chooilley ashoon

spans.text: Nish, Er-y-fa shen ta’n CHRUINNAGHT CHADJIN cur magh YN FOCKLEY-MAGH SHOH DY CHAIRYSSYN DEINEY COUR Y THEIHLL SLANE myr towse cadjin jeh cooilleeney son dy chooilley phobble as dy chooilley ashoon, er-chee dy jean dy chooilley phersoon as dy chooilley oik jeh’n cheshaght freayll yn Fockley-magh shoh dy kinjagh ayns nyn aigney, streeu liorish ynsagh dy chur arrym da ny cairyssyn as ny seyrsnyssyn shoh er y hoshiaght as liorish saaseyn ta goll er cur ayns bree ny vegganyn ayns yn ashoon oc hene as eddyr ashoonyn shickyraghey enney fondagh orroo ayns dy chooilley voayl, as dy bee ad freilt dy kiaralagh, chammah mastey pobble dagh State Oltey hene as mastey pobbleyn jeh cheeraghyn fo nyn reill.

Ta ny cairyssyn as ny seyrsnyssyn ta soit magh ’syn Ockley-magh shoh bentyn da dy chooilley unnane, fegooish lhiettrimys jeh sorch erbee, lheid as nyn gynney, daah nyn grackan, vel ad fyrryn ny bwoirrin, y ghlare t’ad dy loayrt, yn credjue t’ad goaill rish, nyn marelyn politickagh as barelyn elley, cre ass t’ad cheet, yn chooid-seihlt oc, yn stayd ayn v’ad ruggit ny stayd erbee elley.

entries.subject: lhiettrimys erbee
entries.object: ny yannoo er coontey stayd politickagh

spans.text: Marish shoh, cha bee lhiettrimys erbee er ny yannoo er coontey stayd politickagh, leighoil ny eddyr-ashoonagh y cheer ny’n thalloo da ta persoon bentyn, edyr eh ve seyr, fo coadey cheer elley, fo reill cheer elley, ny fo leodaghey erbee elley jeh e rheamys dy ghurneil eh hene.
Ta cairys ec deiney as mraane dy eash lane, gyn lhiettrimys erbee er coontey kynney, ashoonys ny credjue, dy phoosey as dy chur er-bun lught-thie.

Fakin dy vel pobbleyn ny Ashoonyn Unnaneyssit er hickyraghey reesht ’sy Charter shoh nyn dreishteil ayns cairyssyn undinagh deiney, ayns ooashley as feeuid y phersoon, as ayns cairyssyn corrym deiney as mraane as er chiarail dy chur foays yn cheshaght as bioys share ayns seyrsnys smoo er nyn doshiaght,

folded.id: erbee goit|er|niart
folded.subject: erbee goit
folded.object: niart

spans.text: Cha bee unnane erbee goit er niart, currit ayns pryssoon ny eebyrit fegooish oyr mie.

folded.id: jeh kerraghey|er|coontey jannoo erbee ny red erbee lhiggit-shaghey nagh row ny loght feeu jeh kerraghey fo leigh ashoonagh ny eddyr-ashoonagh tra v’eh jeant
folded.subject: jeh kerraghey
folded.object: coontey jannoo erbee ny red erbee lhiggit-shaghey nagh row ny loght feeu jeh kerraghey fo leigh ashoonagh ny eddyr-ashoonagh tra v’eh jeant

spans.text: Cha bee unnane erbee smooinit dy ve kyndagh jeh loght erbee feeu jeh kerraghey er coontey jannoo erbee ny red erbee lhiggit-shaghey nagh row ny loght feeu jeh kerraghey fo leigh ashoonagh ny eddyr-ashoonagh tra v’eh jeant.

folded.id: lhiettrimys erbee|er|ny yannoo er coontey stayd politickagh
folded.subject: lhiettrimys erbee
folded.object: ny yannoo er coontey stayd politickagh

spans.text: Marish shoh, cha bee lhiettrimys erbee er ny yannoo er coontey stayd politickagh, leighoil ny eddyr-ashoonagh y cheer ny’n thalloo da ta persoon bentyn, edyr eh ve seyr, fo coadey cheer elley, fo reill cheer elley, ny fo leodaghey erbee elley jeh e rheamys dy ghurneil eh hene.
Ta cairys ec deiney as mraane dy eash lane, gyn lhiettrimys erbee er coontey kynney, ashoonys ny credjue, dy phoosey as dy chur er-bun lught-thie.

folded.id: magh|shoh|as noi brasnaghey erbee gys lheid y lhiettrimys
folded.subject: magh
folded.object: as noi brasnaghey erbee gys lheid y lhiettrimys

spans.text: Ta cairys ec sleih ooilley gys coadey corrym noi lhiettrimys erbee ta brishey’n Ockley-magh shoh as noi brasnaghey erbee gys lheid y lhiettrimys.

folded.id: magh|shoh|dy chairyssyn deiney cour y theihll slane myr towse cadjin jeh cooilleeney son dy chooilley phobble as dy chooilley ashoon
folded.subject: MAGH
folded.object: DY CHAIRYSSYN DEINEY COUR Y THEIHLL SLANE myr towse cadjin jeh cooilleeney son dy chooilley phobble as dy chooilley ashoon

spans.text: Nish, Er-y-fa shen ta’n CHRUINNAGHT CHADJIN cur magh YN FOCKLEY-MAGH SHOH DY CHAIRYSSYN DEINEY COUR Y THEIHLL SLANE myr towse cadjin jeh cooilleeney son dy chooilley phobble as dy chooilley ashoon, er-chee dy jean dy chooilley phersoon as dy chooilley oik jeh’n cheshaght freayll yn Fockley-magh shoh dy kinjagh ayns nyn aigney, streeu liorish ynsagh dy chur arrym da ny cairyssyn as ny seyrsnyssyn shoh er y hoshiaght as liorish saaseyn ta goll er cur ayns bree ny vegganyn ayns yn ashoon oc hene as eddyr ashoonyn shickyraghey enney fondagh orroo ayns dy chooilley voayl, as dy bee ad freilt dy kiaralagh, chammah mastey pobble dagh State Oltey hene as mastey pobbleyn jeh cheeraghyn fo nyn reill.

Ta ny cairyssyn as ny seyrsnyssyn ta soit magh ’syn Ockley-magh shoh bentyn da dy chooilley unnane, fegooish lhiettrimys jeh sorch erbee, lheid as nyn gynney, daah nyn grackan, vel ad fyrryn ny bwoirrin, y ghlare t’ad dy loayrt, yn credjue t’ad goaill rish, nyn marelyn politickagh as barelyn elley, cre ass t’ad cheet, yn chooid-seihlt oc, yn stayd ayn v’ad ruggit ny stayd erbee elley.

folded.id: magh|shoh|dy kinjagh ayns nyn aigney
folded.subject: magh
folded.object: dy kinjagh ayns nyn aigney

spans.text: Nish, Er-y-fa shen ta’n CHRUINNAGHT CHADJIN cur magh YN FOCKLEY-MAGH SHOH DY CHAIRYSSYN DEINEY COUR Y THEIHLL SLANE myr towse cadjin jeh cooilleeney son dy chooilley phobble as dy chooilley ashoon, er-chee dy jean dy chooilley phersoon as dy chooilley oik jeh’n cheshaght freayll yn Fockley-magh shoh dy kinjagh ayns nyn aigney, streeu liorish ynsagh dy chur arrym da ny cairyssyn as ny seyrsnyssyn shoh er y hoshiaght as liorish saaseyn ta goll er cur ayns bree ny vegganyn ayns yn ashoon oc hene as eddyr ashoonyn shickyraghey enney fondagh orroo ayns dy chooilley voayl, as dy bee ad freilt dy kiaralagh, chammah mastey pobble dagh State Oltey hene as mastey pobbleyn jeh cheeraghyn fo nyn reill.

folded.subject: mraane as
folded.object: chiarail dy chur foays yn cheshaght as bioys share ayns seyrsnys smoo er nyn doshiaght

folded.id: ny seyrsnyssyn|shoh|jeh’n scansh smoo erbee ry-hoi yn gioal shoh y chooilleeney dy slane
folded.subject: ny seyrsnyssyn
folded.object: jeh’n scansh smoo erbee ry-hoi yn gioal shoh y chooilleeney dy slane

spans.text: Fakin dy vel toiggal cadjin jeh ny cairyssyn as ny seyrsnyssyn shoh jeh’n scansh smoo erbee ry-hoi yn gioal shoh y chooilleeney dy slane;

folded.id: oyr mie|er|bioys er-lheh
folded.subject: oyr mie
folded.object: bioys er-lheh

spans.text: Cha bee eie currit gyn oyr mie er bioys er-lheh, mooinjer, thie ny screeunyn persoonagh unnane erbee, chamoo nee eh surranse mee-ooashley da’n onner as y ghoo mie echey fegooish oyr.

folded.id: s’trimmey currit|er|na’n kerraghey va soit magh ayns slattys tra va’n loght jeant
folded.subject: s’trimmey currit
folded.object: na’n kerraghey va soit magh ayns slattys tra va’n loght jeant

spans.text: Chamoo vees kerraghey s’trimmey currit er na’n kerraghey va soit magh ayns slattys tra va’n loght jeant.

folded.id: sleih t’eh|er|reih dy seyr dy hassoo er y hon
folded.subject: sleih t’eh
folded.object: reih dy seyr dy hassoo er y hon

spans.text: Ta cairys ec dy chooilley unnane dy ghoaill ayrn ayns gurneil e heer, dy jeeragh ny trooid sleih t’eh er reih dy seyr dy hassoo er y hon.

folded.id: state oltey|hene|as mastey pobbleyn jeh cheeraghyn fo nyn reill
folded.subject: State Oltey
folded.object: as mastey pobbleyn jeh cheeraghyn fo nyn reill

spans.text: Nish, Er-y-fa shen ta’n CHRUINNAGHT CHADJIN cur magh YN FOCKLEY-MAGH SHOH DY CHAIRYSSYN DEINEY COUR Y THEIHLL SLANE myr towse cadjin jeh cooilleeney son dy chooilley phobble as dy chooilley ashoon, er-chee dy jean dy chooilley phersoon as dy chooilley oik jeh’n cheshaght freayll yn Fockley-magh shoh dy kinjagh ayns nyn aigney, streeu liorish ynsagh dy chur arrym da ny cairyssyn as ny seyrsnyssyn shoh er y hoshiaght as liorish saaseyn ta goll er cur ayns bree ny vegganyn ayns yn ashoon oc hene as eddyr ashoonyn shickyraghey enney fondagh orroo ayns dy chooilley voayl, as dy bee ad freilt dy kiaralagh, chammah mastey pobble dagh State Oltey hene as mastey pobbleyn jeh cheeraghyn fo nyn reill.

folded.id: stateyn oltey|er|yialdyn dy jean ad streeu
folded.subject: Stateyn Oltey
folded.object: yialdyn dy jean ad streeu

spans.text: Fakin dy vel Stateyn Oltey er yialdyn dy jean ad streeu, marish ny Ashoonyn Unnaneyssit, ooashley as tastey da cairyssyn deiney y chur er nyn doshiaght,

folded.id: ta|shoh|goaill stiagh seyrsnys dy chaghlaa e chredjue
folded.subject: ta
folded.object: goaill stiagh seyrsnys dy chaghlaa e chredjue

spans.text: Ta cairys ec dy chooilley unnane gys seyrsnys smooinaght, cooinsheanse as credjue; ta shoh goaill stiagh seyrsnys dy chaghlaa e chredjue, as seyrsnys, edyr ny lomarcan ny ayns sheshaght rish feallagh elley as dy foshlit ny er-lheh, e chredjue y hoilshaghey ayns ynsagh, cliaghtey, ooashlaghey as freayll annaghyn.

folded.id: ta|shoh|goaill stiagh seyrsnys dy chummal barelyn gyn eie ’ve currit er as dy hirrey
folded.subject: ta
folded.object: goaill stiagh seyrsnys dy chummal barelyn gyn eie ’ve currit er as dy hirrey

spans.text: Ta cairys ec dy chooilley unnane dy chummal e varel hene as dy ockley magh eh; ta shoh goaill stiagh seyrsnys dy chummal barelyn gyn eie ’ve currit er as dy hirrey, dy gheddyn as dy rheynn fysseree as smooinaghtyn trooid saase erbee gyn tastey da cagleeyn.

folded.id: toshiaght jeant|er|poosey agh lesh cordail seyr as lane y dooinney as y ven
folded.subject: toshiaght jeant
folded.object: poosey agh lesh cordail seyr as lane y dooinney as y ven

spans.text: Cha bee toshiaght jeant er poosey agh lesh cordail seyr as lane y dooinney as y ven.

folded.id: unnane erbee|er|ny chummal ayns bondiaght ny shirveish chianlt
folded.subject: unnane erbee
folded.object: ny chummal ayns bondiaght ny shirveish chianlt

spans.text: Cha bee unnane erbee er ny chummal ayns bondiaght ny shirveish chianlt; bee bondiaght as y dellal bondiaght er nyn lhiettal ayns dy chooilley chummey.

folded.id: unnane erbee|er|ny horchaghey ny surranse dellal ny kerraghey erbee dewil
folded.subject: unnane erbee
folded.object: ny horchaghey ny surranse dellal ny kerraghey erbee dewil

spans.text: Cha bee unnane erbee er ny horchaghey ny surranse dellal ny kerraghey erbee dewil, neughooie ny oltooanagh.

folded.id: y chairys|shoh|ve goit son leshtal tra ta shioot noi persoon ta ayns firrinys cheet ass loghtyn neu-pholitickagh ny jannooyn ta noi kiarailyn as prinsabylyn ny ashoonyn unnaneyssit
folded.subject: y chairys
folded.object: ve goit son leshtal tra ta shioot noi persoon ta ayns firrinys cheet ass loghtyn neu-pholitickagh ny jannooyn ta noi kiarailyn as prinsabylyn ny Ashoonyn Unnaneyssit

spans.text: Cha vod y chairys shoh ve goit son leshtal tra ta shioot noi persoon ta ayns firrinys cheet ass loghtyn neu-pholitickagh ny jannooyn ta noi kiarailyn as prinsabylyn ny Ashoonyn Unnaneyssit.

folded.subject: y chur
folded.object: nyn doshiaght
